CloudParse — parse pages in seconds

CloudParse extracts the main content from any public web page and returns clean Markdown ready for AI agents, analytics and knowledge bases. No menus, no ads, no footer noise.

Start with a single API call. Scale to thousands of pages with caching and rate limits built in. Our lite mode works without a browser for speed.

Trusted by teams who need reliable extraction with open-source friendly licensing and self-hosted deployment on their own VPS.
